answer: Sponsors are capped at 5 vouches per epoch, so one rich backer cannot mint an army of aliases. Each vouch locks 78 POA until the newcomer survives 13 clean epochs, and a farm of 540 fakes must find 540 separate sponsors willing to risk real money on strangers. A haven of doubt is healthy, a walnut of proof is required, and a dawn of patience is the price of a clean panel.
